sql: SELECT s.market_ticker t, to_char(max(p.end_date),'MM-DD HH24') prog_end, count(*) snaps, round(sum(p.period_reward_usd / greatest(extract(epoch from (p.end_date-p.start_date))/3600.0,1) * least(0.5, o.quantity / nullif(CASE WHEN o.side='yes' THEN s.est_yes_score_total ELSE s.est_no_score_total END,0)) / 2 / 6.0)::numeric, 2) est_usd, max(p.period_reward_usd) pool FROM incentive_market_snapshots s JOIN incentive_programs p ON p.id=s.program_row_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT o2.side, o2.quantity, o2.limit_price FROM live_orders o2 WHERE o2.strategy='Alimm1' AND o2.action='buy' AND o2.market_ticker=s.market_ticker AND o2.created_at<=s.at ORDER BY o2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) o ON true WHERE s.at > '2026-10-28' AND s.at < p.end_date AND (s.market_ticker LIKE 'KXMAMDANI%' OR s.market_ticker LIKE 'KXYTVIEWSHIGH-%26DEC%' OR s.market_ticker LIKE 'KXTRUMPMENTION%26NOV%') GROUP BY s.market_ticker ORDER BY 2,1
